title: firescale affected plan
description: What `fscale verify --affected --dry-run --json` prints: which units a change would run, and why (ADR 0079). Nothing is run to make it.

base.description: The --base ref, or null when the change is the uncommitted one.

everything.description: Why every unit runs, or null when the change reaches only some.

units.description: The repo root's own steps first (no project), then each project, in plan order.

project.description: The project's folder. Absent for the repo root's own steps.

affected.description: True when a run would run this unit.

steps.description: The steps of the unit that have a command.

warnings.description: What the project graph cannot see, such as dynamic imports.

reason.description: A reason with a type to switch on and the same reason in words. A new type may be added without a new schemaVersion: treat an unknown type as `other`.

files.description: changed-file: the changed files the unit holds.

on.description: depends-on: the folder of the node it depends on.

sources.description: depends-on: the kinds of evidence for the edge, as `fscale graph --explain` names them.

file.description: The file that makes everything run.

steps.description: config-setting: the steps the changed setting reaches. Empty for a setting every step shares, and when the base's config could not be read.
